rationale: The current strategy compares all four prior bars with the signal-bar EMA values and confirms only a break of the last two bars. Use the indicator available at each completed bar and require the resumption to clear the intervening structure since its latest touch.
condition: Keep all existing H1 regime, M15 alignment, RSI, candle quality, four-bar pullback window, eight-bar breakout window and numerical limits.
For a long pullback, at least one of the preceding four completed bars has low <= that bar EMA20; for short, high >= that bar EMA20.
Each preceding four completed bars closes strictly above its own EMA50 for long, or strictly below its own EMA50 for short.

Select the most recent qualifying touch. The signal is directional and closes above every high (long) or below every low (short) from that touch through the final pre-signal bar. Retain the existing prior-two-bar break, so the resumption comparison begins at the earlier of the latest touch and the penultimate pre-signal bar.
The separate breakout branch remains available; changing pullback membership does not exclude an entry that still qualifies as breakout.
claims: This is a structural live-experiment candidate, not a demonstrated defect or validated profitability improvement.
No parameters are selected by the outcomes. All retained trades and available attempted setups are reported.
